sources.title: Cidades
sources.date: current page; publication date not shown
sources.proves: Official 99 service inventory exactly lists Rio de Janeiro and Florianópolis as served cities and Baia da Ilha Grande as a served Rio de Janeiro region. It does not list Angra dos Reis by name, so Angra/Ilha Grande is region-supported rather than city-supported.

sources.title: Aliança pela Mobilidade Sustentável
sources.proves: Official 99 page says the app facilitates mobility for more than 40 million Brazilians in 3,300 municipalities; supports Brazil country-level inheritance, not a specific Angra service claim.

sources.title: Servicios de DiDi por Ciudad
sources.proves: Official DiDi Colombia city inventory names both Barranquilla and Cartagena.

sources.title: Angra receberá novo catamarã da CCR Barcas
sources.proves: Official municipal notice identifies the Angra–Vila do Abraão public route and reported a 40-minute catamaran trip at launch. It is historical operating evidence, not a current timetable.

sources.title: Ordenamento do Turismo Náutico
sources.publisher: Prefeitura de Angra dos Reis / TurisAngra
sources.proves: Official planning document says Vila do Abraão has Estação Abraão and the Barcas pier, and describes nautical-tourism boarding infrastructure.

sources.title: Caderno Leitura Técnica
sources.proves: Official technical plan says Cais da Lapa is used by ferries and Cais de Santa Luzia by other vessels; validates real mainland boarding infrastructure.

sources.title: Milhares de turistas desembarcam em Angra neste domingo
sources.publisher: Prefeitura de Angra dos Reis / TurisAngra
sources.proves: Municipal report says more than 190,000 cruise tourists disembarked in the prior season and 54 calls were expected through April 2025. This is cruise/tourism context, not ferry-route demand.

sources.title: Barcas Rio
sources.publisher: Barcas Rio / Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro
sources.proves: Current official operator site confirms the state ferry system and schedule/fleet context; individual line frequencies must be checked on the live timetable at handoff.

sources.title: Tarifa das barcas será reajustada em fevereiro
sources.publisher: Secretaria de Transporte e Mobilidade Urbana, Governo do RJ
sources.proves: Official notice says Arariboia, Cocotá and Paquetá fares become R$5.00 from 8 February; page year was not exposed by the scraper, so effective-year confirmation remains required before economics.

sources.title: Barcas batem sexto recorde de passageiros em oito meses
sources.publisher: Secretaria de Transporte e Mobilidade Urbana, Governo do RJ
sources.proves: Official state report records 58,000+ system boardings in one day and 7,928 boardings on Charitas that day; these are peak-day observations, not annual demand.

sources.title: Números do aeroporto
sources.proves: Official airport statistics report 17,906,990 passengers in Jan–Dec 2025 and monthly 2026 figures. Airport throughput is a top-of-funnel signal only.

sources.title: Florianópolis no Mar
sources.proves: Official municipal study says regular lacustrine passenger lines exist only on Lagoa da Conceição, serving land-isolated Costa da Lagoa; supports a real current water-mobility use case.

sources.title: Cooperbarco
sources.proves: Operator page lists Costa da Lagoa boat service as daily and displays a R$30 fare; exact fare basis, passenger category and page update date require reconfirmation before modeling.

sources.title: Recorde histórico: Floripa Airport ultrapassa 5 milhões de passageiros em 2025
sources.proves: Official release reports 5.1 million airport passengers in 2025, including 1.2 million international. This is broad visitor throughput, not route demand.

sources.title: Muelle La Bodeguita, lugar autorizado para el transporte público de pasajeros hacia las islas
sources.proves: Maritime authority confirms Muelle La Bodeguita is an authorized public-passenger departure point toward island destinations and describes safety/terminal controls.

sources.title: Indicadores de Turismo: Cartagena de Indias, diciembre 2023
sources.proves: Official tourism bulletin reports 619,282 passenger entries at Muelle La Bodeguita in 2023 versus 586,160 in 2022 (+6%). It is mixed terminal entries, not a route-specific one-way count.

sources.title: Traslado lancha rápida Isla Grande–Cartagena
sources.proves: Current operator product page shows COP115,000 transfer price plus COP40,000 port tax, Cartagena departures 08:00–09:00, Isla Grande return 14:00, and about 50 minutes. Price direction/product inclusions need booking-screen reconfirmation.

sources.title: Aeronáutica Civil publica el ranking de movilización de pasajeros durante 2023
sources.proves: Official table reports 6,388,148 passengers at Cartagena Rafael Núñez and 3,184,185 at Barranquilla Ernesto Cortissoz in 2023. Airport counts are not marine-route demand.

sources.title: Río-Bus: ruta completa de la embarcación por el río Magdalena
sources.proves: Official city project page documents the Río-Bus vessel demonstration/project and proposed river-station network. It does not prove a currently scheduled passenger service.

sources.title: Florianópolis para crianças: 10 roteiros a pé pela capital
sources.proves: Official visitor guide says Costa da Lagoa is reached by boat, corroborating water-dependence and tourism relevance but not volumes or fares.

sources.title: Praça Arariboia – Praça XV
sources.publisher: Barcas Rio / Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro
sources.date: live page; publication date not shown

sources.title: Praça XV – Charitas
sources.publisher: Barcas Rio / Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro
sources.date: live page; publication date not shown

sources.title: Praça XV – Paquetá
sources.publisher: Barcas Rio / Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro
sources.date: live page; publication date not shown

sources.title: Praça XV – Cocotá
sources.publisher: Barcas Rio / Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro

sources.title: Cartagena de Indias – Balance cierre 2025
sources.proves: Official 2025 tourism bulletin reports 745,079 passengers moved through Muelle La Bodeguita Jan–Dec 2025 (+18.2% vs 2024), 19,155 sailings, 56+ island destinations, 295 registered vessels and 100 operators; it also reports 3,822,913 air arrivals in 2025. Terminal traffic is mixed and not route/direction-specific.

sources.title: Más de 48 mil pasajeros se movilizaron por vía marítima desde Cartagena durante Semana Santa: DIMAR
sources.proves: DIMAR reports 48,479 maritime passengers moved in 2,830 vessels during eight days of Holy Week 2025 from La Bodeguita, Pegasos, marinas and other Cartagena points, up 12% from 2024. This is an event-period multi-origin total, not annual or route-specific demand.
